summary: Comprehensive backend testing for Suraksha Diary. Seeded db.admin_sessions with session_token='test-token-xyz' and exercised all 15 requested backend behaviors against external URL https://incident-log-dera.preview.emergentagent.com. 22/22 checks passed including Hindi Devanagari round-trip (JSON + CSV BOM + PDF), Whisper audio path (returned 200 with empty transcript for silent WAV, did NOT 500), auth enforcement, filters (status/urgent_only/q/zone), push subscribe/vapid-key, and PDF/CSV export.
passed: POST /api/incidents (no auth) accepts Hindi text; UUID id, ISO created_at, status='new'; Hindi round-trips (Content-Type includes charset=utf-8)
POST /api/incidents with tiny valid WAV audio_base64 -> 200 with transcript field present (empty string for silence), audio_url stored as data URL, NO 500
POST /api/incidents with raw photo_base64 stored as data:image/... URL
GET /api/incidents/mine?reporter_name=... returns only that reporter's incidents (no auth)
GET /api/incidents with valid X-Session-Token returns array; filters status, urgent_only=true, q=Hindi search, zone all work
GET /api/incidents/{id} returns 200 for valid; 404 for unknown id
PATCH /api/incidents/{id} updates status and office_notes; updated_at refreshed
POST /api/push/subscribe requires admin (401 without token, 200 with token, stored in db.push_subscriptions)
GET /api/auth/me returns email/name with token; 401 without
GET /api/export/csv returns text/csv; charset=utf-8 with UTF-8 BOM and Hindi headers (दिनांक etc.)
notes: Whisper returned empty string transcript for the silent test WAV — endpoint behaves correctly (no 500). Hindi Devanagari verified end-to-end in JSON responses, MongoDB queries (regex Hindi search worked), CSV (BOM + Hindi headers), and PDF (application/pdf bytes). Admin auth via mock session_token in db.admin_sessions works exactly as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
